preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some MetaPets tokens to benefit from fee manipulation

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMarketingWallet() to set the marketing address to the attacker's address, then setMarketingFeePercent() to a high value (e.g., 100). This will redirect all transaction fees to the attacker's address. Perform token transfers to trigger fee collection. Alternatively, set tax and liquidity fees to zero and exclude the attacker from fees to avoid paying any fees on transfers.
